definitions.gloss: to suit one well; to look natural in a role; to be a good fit
definitions.explanation: To have grown into a role, position, or style so that it looks completely natural and well-suited. Originally from the theater, referring to how a costume looks on an actor.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{板|いた}に{着|つ}いてきた。
examples.english: He's starting to look natural in a suit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{管理職|かんりしょく}→管理職：21834_kanrishoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{板|いた}に{着|つ}いた。
examples.english: She's completely settled into the management role.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違和感|いわかん}→違和感：06249_iwakan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧{板|いた}に{着|つ}いてきた。
examples.english: It felt awkward at first, but it's gradually become a natural fit.

notes:
An idiomatic expression from the theater world. ⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧ refers to the stage (boards), and the expression originally meant that an actor's performance or costume looked natural and fitting on stage.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{板|いた}に{着|つ}く: ~ suits one well
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{板|いた}に{着|つ}いてきた: ~ is starting to look natural
- ⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{板|いた}に{着|つ}いた: has completely settled in

USAGE:
Used as a compliment, often about someone who was new to a role or style but has grown into it. Common contexts include:
- New positions or job titles
- Clothing or appearance changes
- New roles in life (parent, teacher, leader)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{似合|にあ}う→似合う：02134_niau⟧: to suit, to look good on — more general, does not imply the process of growing into something
- ⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to look the part — similar meaning but more colloquial
